name: Organizational change

subjectOf.text: The most important consequence of legal startups is that the legal profession will be forced to innovate in perpetuity, a task that overextended and cumbersome legal organizations which have lost the capacity for rapid re-invention cannot easily accomplish.
subjectOf.abstract: Second, and most importantly, the legal profession will be forced by such startup companies to innovate in perpetuity, a task that is not easily accomplished by overextended and – often – cumbersome legal organizations that have lost the capacity for rapid re-invention.
subjectOf.citation: Mark Fenwick, Wulf A. Kaal, Erik P.M. Vermeulen, Legal Education in a Digital Age Why 'Coding for Lawyers' Matters (2018). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3227967
scope_conditions: incumbent law firms and legal departments facing startup competition

subjectOf.text: Intellectual property growth functions as a leading indicator of workplace change: industries and regions with higher IP growth experience faster shifts in job roles, skill requirements, and organizational structures.
subjectOf.abstract: Industries and regions with higher levels of IP growth often experience more rapid changes in job roles, skill requirements, and organizational structures.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Quantum Economy and the Future of Work (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4900880
